title: 理科教育法Ⅱ
subtitle: Educational Methods for Science II
educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge necessary for teaching science in secondary education, and aim to acquire skills for making and doing a science lesson.
advice:
In order to acquire skill for a science lesson, we will cover the following materials.

 1. The analysis of textbooks in secondary education
 2. How to make a lesson plan for science in secondary education
 3. In each area of science, physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science, the students make a lesson plan and discuss it with each other to improve the plan
4. Each of students will make lesson practices, and discuss about them.

The above learning activities will help the students acquire skills for making and doing a science lesson. The students need efforts outside class hours. We expect the students to consider deeply about an effective science lesson.
books: The Course of Study “Science”, by Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, JAPAN

activityGoals.body: Understand the course of study of “Science”, make a lesson plan.
Conduct a lesson and acquire basic skills for practical science lesson.
Identify improvements of the science lesson you made.
Be able to understand good points of others’ lesson and apply them to improve your lesson.
Engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand textbooks in “Science” and make plans how to use them effectively.

(2) Create teaching plans and materials which take into account students' actual conditions.

(3) Be aware of good points of your lesson-making and have your own opinion about an effective lesson of Science.

(4) Recognize points for improvement of a lesson you made, and modify them for an effective lesson of Science.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand textbooks in “Mathematics”.

(2) Create teaching plans.

(3) Be aware of good points of your lesson-making.

(4)  Recognize points for improvement of a lesson you made.
